overviewHtml:
Teams running deployments with ArgoCD lack a view of sync activity and application states. This Terraform project integrates ArgoCD with Dynatrace so you can see sync history and deployment health in one place.

What you get

  • Dashboards for ArgoCD application lifecycle and platform observability
  • OpenPipeline ingest source and pipeline for normalized SDLC events
  • Insight to optimize your ArgoCD deployments
prereqsHtml: • Install Dynatrace Configuration as Code via Terraform
setupHtml:
1. Create a Platform token with the following permissions.
  • Run apps: app-engine:apps:run
  • View OpenPipeline configurations: settings:objects:read
  • Edit OpenPipeline configurations: settings:objects:write
  • Create and edit documents: document:documents:write
  • View documents: document:documents:read
  1. Store the retrieved platform token in an environment variable.

Windows:

    $env:DYNATRACE_PLATFORM_TOKEN='<YOUR_PLATFORM_TOKEN>'

Linux / macOS:

    export DYNATRACE_PLATFORM_TOKEN='<YOUR_PLATFORM_TOKEN>'
  1. Store your Dynatrace environment URL in an environment variable. Make sure to replace ` with your Dynatrace environment ID, e.g. abc12345`.

Windows:

    $env:DYNATRACE_ENV_URL='https://<YOUR-DT-ENV-ID>.apps.dynatrace.com'

Linux / macOS:

    export DYNATRACE_ENV_URL='https://<YOUR-DT-ENV-ID>.apps.dynatrace.com'
  1. Clone the Dynatrace configuration as code sample repository using the following commands and move to the argocd_observability_terraform directory.
    git clone https://github.com/Dynatrace/dynatrace-configuration-as-code-samples.git
    cd dynatrace-configuration-as-code-samples/argocd_observability_terraform
getStartedHtml:
You need Terraform and a Dynatrace platform token.

  1. Create a platform token and set your environment URL
  2. Apply the Terraform configuration

Full setup instructions are in the README.
